title: "Corona" Semi Coed 4x4x4
description: The Tournament where you get 4 hits! $$$$ payout "CORONA" Rule… Teams may call out “Corona” in order to gain a fourth hit – Here is how it works: During play, while the ball is on your side of the net and before the third contact, you can call out “Corona” and your team can, and MUST, use a fourth hit to send the ball over the net. This is regardless of who is hitting the ball on your team. Any given rally can have multiple “Corona” calls, there is no limit. You cannot call out a fake “Corona” , nor can you try to call it out for the other team. And when you do call it out, it must be loud enough for both the referee and the opposing team to hear.
